Subject: Next steps — MSA/DPA dependencies and evaluation gating

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We're excited about Redwood's latency and cost numbers. Procurement & Legal asked me to pull together a short mutual action plan so we can track what needs to land to get to PO and production access. Quick asks from our side:

- Can you share a draft MAP with clear ownership, deliverables, and sign-off gates (MSA, DPA, order form)?
- We need SOC2 and dataflow evidence for our security review (links or a summary PDF).
- Procurement needs to confirm what triggers the PO: is it signature of MSA + order form, or do you allow a provisional order form with MSA-only?

Ideal if we can get a doc by Friday so our legal can start redlining. Can we also set a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through sequencing?

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Procurement Manager
Olive Health

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-20T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — MSA/DPA dependencies and evaluation gating

Hi Maria — great to meet you yesterday. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (Olive_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a draft order form. High-level sequencing we recommend:

1) Legal review & parallel redlines (MSA + DPA) — target: 2 business days for initial comments from Olive.
2) SOC2 / evidence intake — we included a one-page summary (redwood-evidence-summary.pdf) and links to artifacts in the Drive.
3) Finalize MSA signature — Redwood typically requires executed MSA before a binding order form, though we can accept an executed MSA with an attached order form pending final pricing schedule sign-off for pilots.
4) Order form execution & PO issuance — procurement issues PO once order form signed.
5) Onboarding & pilot (30-day pilot window) — production toggles after PO + onboarding checklist.

A couple of clarifying notes included in the MAP: owner column, target dates, and "blocking items" for each lane (legal, security, procurement, implementation). Can you confirm who from Olive Legal will be the reviewer so Laura (copied) can loop in our counsel?

Proposed next step: 30-min call Wednesday 8/25 10:00 AM PT to walk the MAP and call out hard dependencies. Let me know if that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Olive_MAP_v1.xlsx; OrderForm-draft-olive.docx; redwood-evidence-summary.pdf

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Maria / Chloe — adding a couple of legal sequencing points so Olive can plan the internal review:

- Preferred sequence: MSA signature first (sets commercial terms and liability caps), then DPA as an addendum or parallel signature depending on Olive's preference. We can accept a redline to the DPA and hold the order form contingent on DPA completion, but we need a signed MSA to move forward with billing/PO.
- If Olive requires a simultaneous signature flow (MSA + DPA + order form), please flag that now — it can extend review time if your legal prefers consolidated redlines.
- Please identify any required contract amendments (e.g., data residency clauses) up front so we can surface standard language.

I've put tentative internal target dates in the MAP: 3 business days for initial redlines from our side after we receive Olive's comments. If your legal needs more time, share the expected SLA and we'll adapt the MAP dates.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria@olivehealth.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — MSA/DPA dependencies and evaluation gating

Adding the acceptance & implementation lane from the engineering side — this is often the gating path for pilots: 

- Acceptance criteria (pilot): throughput >= 30 req/s for 50ms P50 inference on the test prompt set; embeddings accuracy within 2% (we'll supply the eval harness).
- Data flows: for the pilot we suggest a VPC peering + limited log retention (30 days) to satisfy your compliance team; permanent retention policies are controlled by the order form/Data Addendum.
- Onboarding milestones: test dataset curated (owner: Olive data team), integration spike (2 days), pilot smoke tests (3 days).

If Olive wants an accelerated schedule, we can prioritize the integration spike but need a signed MSA to provision dedicated capacity for predictable throughput. Otherwise we can run a best-effort hosted pilot.

I'll attach a short implementation checklist into the Drive referenced in the MAP. Chloe — happy to join the 8/25 call to walk the tech lanes.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Success & Integrations
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
